variants.headline: Looking back: building project badly behind schedule
variants.sub: Construction of a building project is severely delayed in {colony}.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: A building project in the colony was badly behind schedule.

A severe delay is a delivery issue, not automatically a quantified cost overrun. Managers should distinguish the schedule position from an assumed financial effect. Commercial scrutiny should concern the actual obligations and delivery record, without filling an incomplete account with a guessed penalty, cause or revised completion date.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We defend {target} against a verdict based on the delay alone. Lateness is established, but its existence does not prove every adverse claim about responsibility or the merits of the project.
